notes: Identical density families share one asset. Paths retain wording, locale, shape, style, and state.
The Arabic sign-in and login labels match. Arabic Sign in black uses the Login with artwork for a legible fingerprint.
The Arabic sign-up and registration labels match. Arabic Sign up black uses the Register Account with artwork for a legible fingerprint.
Authorize artwork is supplied as one PNG per variant, at 4x.
Black icon artwork is supplied by the older official archives because the current files show a black fingerprint on black. The 2x and 3x files are rasterized from the older SVGs.
